compendium.summary: A normal 2024 Wizard summon—not restricted to Illusionists. Consider a sustained extra combatant when concentration-based area control is a poor fit.
warnings: Tier is a situational Compendium assessment, not a letter grade quoted from Pack Tactics.
tactics: Compare the sustained contribution of one summon with Hypnotic Pattern or Sleet Storm. Cost, survivability, available targets and encounter length determine the better choice.

Illusionist 6 also grants a feature-specific version. Do not import the research's unverified assertion that a slotless Fey necessarily has zero attacks; use the active stat block and feature wording.

Buy the retained 300+ gp flower before preparing the spell. The ally takes its turn immediately after yours and follows verbal commands without your action; without commands it Dodges and avoids danger.
